claims.statement: Harden MathJax rendering when collapsible details are opened.
Reject malformed TeX escaping/control-character traps in JSON data.
Enforce touch-safe option targets on iPad/mobile.
Add explicit bottom-of-page Practice and Readiness CTAs.
Use score bands >=80 READY, 50-79 REVIEW_RECOMMENDED, <50 MORE_EVIDENCE_NEEDED.

proposed_changes.change: Re-typeset formulas when details open and ensure option layouts do not overflow.
Add bottom CTAs to Practice and Readiness.

uncertainties: Score-band proposal conflicts with current semantic definition of MORE_EVIDENCE_NEEDED.

acceptance.notes: Technical hardening accepted; low-score -> MORE_EVIDENCE_NEEDED rejected because evidence sufficiency and performance are distinct concepts.
